title: Jati Hai Bahen Utho Bhayya
body:
Roro ke ye di Zainab ne sada
Roro ke ye di Zainab ne sada jaati hai behan utho bhaiya, aab karke tera chehlum dukhiya jaati hai behan utho bhaiya
Kya kehke manau laila ko doo kaise dilasa kubra ko, tum aake inhe samjhaozara jaati hai behan utho bhaiya
Parde ka nigehbaa koi nahi aab haal ka pursa koi nahi, sab chod gaye mujhkotanha jaati hai behan utho bhaiya
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar nange phiri baazaro mein jaana hi pada darbaro mein, har tarah ke seh ker zulm-o-jafa jaati hai behan utho bhaiya
Ek thais jigar per lagti thi jab ro ke Sakina kehti thi, kis ja hai phupi baba mera jaati hai behan utho bhaiya
Kurta bhi jala gouhar bhi chinne bachi ne tamache bhi khaye, tha sara badan zakhmi uska jaati hai behan utho bhaiya..
